scalingDecisions.reason: The broad 06:00 queue covered 16 events in three sports with 54 preserved forecast records, warranting one NCAAF complete-event researcher and one independent full-board reviewer while the coordinator owned the remaining events and merge.

The routine pool and coordinator resolved all positive-lead reviews; the 12 remaining exact-reference gaps were documented selection-level shortfalls rather than consequential unanswered delegated questions.

qualityFindings: The reviewer corrected the BetBetter handicap sign: positive home handicap means the home team is behind, so those native point opinions supported the market favorite rather than the underdog.

Ten original-clock positive moneyline leads were explicitly reviewed; exact Pinnacle evidence was unfavorable or effectively neutral at the bound prices and current personnel sources retained material availability uncertainty, so none was adopted as a zero-stake directional LEAN.
The researcher preserved ESPN access and prediction-tracker limitations rather than claiming refreshed model points, and retained the original captured observation clocks.
